news.title: Welcome to Nectar
news.caption: A fic-aware AO3 & Ambrosia reader, sideloaded via AltStore.

apps.name: Nectar
apps.subtitle: Fic-aware AO3 & Ambrosia reader
apps.localizedDescription: Nectar reads Archive of Our Own's RSS feeds and loads each work's full text with saved reading position, offline-friendly caching, and a distraction-free reader. It's also the companion app for Ambrosia, a local fanfiction library with fic-specific metadata -- word count, chapters, fandom, rating, warnings, series -- for large personal collections AO3's own feeds can't cover.
